llm_response.reason: The website claims to offer Jean Paul Gaultier products at 'outlet' prices, yet the domain was registered very recently and not by the actual brand. WHOIS information is fully privacy-protected and the domain is on hold, which are common for scam sites. Site contact/info pages are unreachable. No real business identifiers or legitimate contact info is displayed. The content and structure mimic established fashion sites, seeking to exploit consumers looking for luxury deals—a known scam technique.
